sentence: This project studies how island bird species form and become different, using genes and computer simulations of brightly colored birds called whistlers.
This project builds faster ways to analyze data in real time, including medical images, using AI and programmable hardware.
This project builds a handheld device that uses printed paper strips to quickly detect cancer and viruses in samples such as saliva and sweat.
This project uses a special kind of light called squeezed light to build a network that senses small changes across large areas more precisely.
This project brings researchers together to discuss ways to analyze very large and complex datasets while measuring how uncertain the results are.
This project studies how the type and amount of dietary fat changes gut microbes, brain function and behavior in chickens.
This project holds conferences to help early career investigators in computer science and engineering write full proposals.
This project develops ways to speed up the training of large AI models, using ideas from numerical methods.
This project develops methods that use ideas from communication theory to study brain connectivity and detect cognitive decline early.
This project runs a high power laser system that outside users can use for experiments, and uses AI to control its beams.
This project studies when the entangled states of many-body quantum systems can be described and checked efficiently by computers.
This project tries to find out which parts a group of bacterial proteins need to work, so they can be developed into gene editing tools.
This project develops ways to control many small energy resources on the power grid so it stays reliable, private and secure against cyber-attacks.
This project creates cybersecurity courses, certificates and a boot camp at a rural college to prepare skilled technicians.
This project builds open-source software that simulates elastic deformations with contact, so material parameters and shapes can be worked out for a goal.
This project uses genetic identification and machine learning to help disrupt illegal wildlife trade involving sharks, rays and turtles.
This project studies how tungsten alloy parts can be built by additive manufacturing with extrusion, binder removal and sintering.
